newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil, Gazprom seal oil exploration agreement.
newsitem.headline: Statoil, Gazprom seal oil exploration agreement.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Monday it had concluded a cooperation agreement with Russia's RAO Gazprom for exploration on the Varandey-more oilfield.
Under the deal Statoil and Gazprom will jointly pursue exploration of the field and will extend cooperation in the area adjacent to the Varandey-more prospect.
The agreement refers only to oil, there were no elements of gas involved in the deal, Statoil said.
Varandey-more, discovered by Gazprom in 1995, lies in 12 to 15 metres of water in the southeast sector of the Pechora Sea, which is in the eastern part of the Barents Sea.
Statoil said a second exploration well was currently under spud on the field. The area has an ice-free weather window of four months per year.
"We consider this a prospective area and Gazprom a strong Russian partner," a company statement said.
Statoil and Gazprom have participating interests of 49 and 51 percent respectively and will share costs.
